blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The city government is shifting to a four‑day work week and scaling back upcoming fiesta and Christmas celebrations to keep its finances afloat amid soaring fuel prices, a weak peso, and the threat of El Niño. City Administrator Angel Navarro said in a message on Friday that Calapan’s 2026 budget of P1.6 billion was prepared last year when diesel stood at P63 per liter, and the US dollar traded at P57 to P58. Today, diesel sells for P90 to P100 per liter while the peso has weakened past the P63 mark, driving up local inflation and […]...
